findings.text: When an error is raised at EOF on line 1, errorPrevLine and error()/errorf() with atEOF decrement Line to 0. An input like `a = "abc` (no trailing newline) gives Position.Line = 0, and ParseError.ErrorWithPosition then indexes `lines[pe.Position.Line-1]` with -1 and panics. The same bad index is used for the context lines when Line is 1 or 2.
